_comment: The trust list. This is the customer's record of which MCP servers it
will talk to and exactly what it approved from each one.
trusted       gate 1 - talk to this server at all?
pinned        gate 2 - sha256 of each descriptor AS APPROVED
known_good    the approved bytes themselves, for the diff and the re-pin
serve_pinned  after a re-pin: use OUR copy, not what the server advertises
OWASP LLM01:2026 prevention 10 asks for exactly this: pin, sign and verify
every MCP server, and audit tool descriptions for hidden instructions.
In production this is a tool registry with owners and a review process.
